{{Quote|Be a pirate for a night at Tawntoom Territory&mdash;Play Point 5 where it was invented! New games every five minutes! Ninety-percent payoffs!|Banner advertisement on Atzerri|<ref name="SOL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>}}
'''Point 5''' was a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] game<ref name="GSWU" /> invented on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]].<ref name="SOL" /> [[Cix Trouvee]] gambled on games of Point 5 among many other games of chance,<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> and it was one of the many games available to passengers aboard the [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] ''[[Lady of Mindor]]'' in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="HSR">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref> and at the [[Illuminated Aquean]] on [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]].<ref name="VA">{{GamerCite|8|The Vaynai Archipelago}}</ref> Around [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], the entertainment district known as [[the Revels]] on Atzerri offered ninety percent payoffs at the original establishment that invented the game.<ref name="SOL" />
